gloss: from now; from this point on; hereafter

definitions.gloss: from now; from this point on; hereafter
definitions.explanation: A formal expression indicating the start of something or marking the transition to what comes next. Used to signal that an event, announcement, or action is about to begin.

definitions.gloss: beyond this point; from here onward
definitions.explanation: Indicates a spatial boundary, marking the area or territory that lies beyond the current position.

examples.japanese: これより{会議|かいぎ}を{始|はじ}めます。
examples.english: We will now begin the meeting.

examples.japanese: これより{式|しき}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}います。
これより{先|さき}の{発言|はつげん}は{議事録|ぎじろく}に{記録|きろく}されますので、ご{注意|ちゅうい}ください。
examples.english: Please be advised that all statements from this point on will be recorded in the minutes.

examples.japanese: これより{先|さき}、{立入禁止|たちいりきんし}。
これより{北|きた}は{雪国|ゆきぐに}だ。
examples.english: North of here is snow country.

examples.japanese: これより{奥|おく}は{登山|とざん}{道|どう}が{険|けわ}しくなりますので、{装備|そうび}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: The mountain trail becomes steep beyond this point, so please check your equipment.

notes:
A formal, somewhat literary expression composed of これ (this) + より (from). Common in official announcements, ceremonies, signage, and formal writing. In everyday speech, the equivalent would be {今|いま}から (from now) for time or ここから (from here) for space.

REGISTER:
Formal. Used in ceremonies, official proceedings, signs, and literary contexts. Rarely heard in casual conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- これより{始|はじ}めます: we will now begin
- これより{先|さき}: beyond this point (temporal or spatial)
- これより{後|あと}: after this

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {今|いま}から: from now — the everyday equivalent for temporal use
- ここから: from here — the everyday equivalent for spatial use
- {以後|いご}: hereafter; from now on — formal, emphasizes ongoing applicability
- {今後|こんご}: from now on; henceforth — formal, forward-looking
